r.notes: One koala resting high in the tree in Belair National park right on a walking trail
Way up high sleeping in fork of tree
Moving around, feeding on the surrounding eucalyptus leaves on the edges of the branches
They are very clever because it was cold and they rested on a lower branch that was closer to the ground so it could stay warm.
High up in a tree in a part of the park that gets less human traffic. This Koala was quite alet. But did not appear to be looking for food.

Funny story, we were at Belair National Park for a wedding and as we were leaving I was commenting to my family that it would have been nice if I could have seen a koala in the park. Just as I finish saying that, my sister looks up into the trees as we are driving along and sees one!!! We stop and turn around and are all able to see him. He looked quite happy, scratched himself a few times and watched us. ??
